g.text: The agent knows the target; its identity is not announced or shown to the participant.
Requested pauses stop active-search timing. Invalid / stale gaze suspends new guidance decisions.
Implementation: 40 + 40 trials, shared command wording, right controller. Proposal: operator / survey flow.
Open: final surveys, signed-height quotas, participant sample size, spatial / timing acceptance and hardware checks.
